name: GigPaybackMath
summary: Gig-economy payback math for Swift: true hourly rate after fees, deactivation risk, equipment payback hours.
description:
Swift math for pricing a side hustle honestly: the true hourly rate
after platform fees and self-employment tax, the pay a gig-app
deactivation eats across its review window, and the hours until a
return pallet or a piece of equipment pays itself back. Pure
Foundation, no dependencies, Decimal throughout so receipt-level
audits never inherit floating-point drift. Built by the Extra
Hustles team, which publishes true-hourly-rate math for side hustlers.
